primary_sample.rule: same games with strict point-in-time eligible raw market forecasts at all four horizons

minimum_formal_inference_gate.interpretation: eligibility to run formal family inference; not automatic authority to select or promote a horizon

later_horizon_can_replace_T120_only_if: T-120m is excluded from the 95% model confidence set under the primary Brier analysis
at least one of T-60m, T-45m or T-30m remains in the model confidence set
paired candidate-minus-T120 Brier improvement has a week-block 95% upper confidence bound below zero
log loss and calibration do not materially contradict the Brier result
the result is coherent under leave-one-week-out and capture-completeness diagnostics
source and point-in-time integrity gates pass
explicit human promotion authorization is granted
horizon_selection_rule.if_multiple_later_horizons_survive: choose the earliest surviving later horizon that satisfies all integrity and product requirements; do not claim superiority among statistically unresolved survivors
horizon_selection_rule.if_T120_survives: do not claim prospective evidence has established that waiting improves probability quality

same_horizon_adjustment_rule.benchmark: raw market consensus at the identical horizon
same_horizon_adjustment_rule.incremental_claim_requires: paired proper-score improvement over the same-horizon raw market, not merely improvement over the earlier T-120 incumbent
